source: 2026 and 2025 public SportsDataverse ESPN CFB PBP (separately collected by explicit pipeline collect --season each year)
reproduction_note: Cross-season workflow correctly downloaded --season 2025, but old runner emitted a hardcoded 2026 source-label string; the code has since been corrected so labels derive from the fixture's year.

interpretation.severity: Directionally improves margin MAE in both years, but effect is about 0.02 points/game on whole slate, bootstrap intervals contain zero, and severe subgroup is underpowered.
interpretation.negative: Negative-designed-run matchup interaction directionally improves margin MAE and Brier in both years, +0.098 in 2026 and +0.0345 in 2025. Neither a genuine forward untouched test nor stable ATS finding. Brier modest.
interpretation.resilience: No modeled evidence: all matchup comparisons missing sufficient source-observed trailing-versus-neutral rushing data, fail closed. No synthetic score-script outcomes claimed.
interpretation.future_test: Freeze one candidate after earlier training and validation; use new pregame 2026 source snapshots and timestamped sportsbook spread quotes to run a prospective paired ATS/margin calibration, with negative-run mechanism as prioritized candidate.
limitations: V2 thresholds revised after inspection of 2026 feature distribution; replication year 2025 is earlier chronologically and not an untouched forward holdout
Repeated tests and selected candidate favor optimism; apparent positive bootstrap interval in 2026 not a multiple-testing adjusted guarantee
No reliable historical bookmaker quotes for scored games; cannot claim 2026 or 2025 ATS hit rate
Retrospective source captures from 2026; historical row-level publication times unverified
Severe 23 and 29 game cohorts have large intervals crossing zero
Score-state resilience/combined have zero valid simulations, not evidence of failure or success
